_meta.source: Shogun Showdown wiki, Tiles page sections on upgrades and tile choices (shogunshowdown.wiki.gg), fetched 2026-10-28, CC BY-SA 4.0; shrine texts as the game prints them [bot: runs 20261027-182237 to 20261028-061420, collect 20261027-164727].

fields.lines: text lines the shrine bubble shows, upper case. seen=true: read on a recorded frame; seen=false: expected wording [hyp]
fields.damage, cooldown, slots: changes applied to the chosen tile
fields.uses_level: false for slot upgrades, which never consume a level [wiki]

rules.levels: Each upgrade consumes one of the tile's max levels (the grey dots above a tile; used levels turn yellow [bot: collect 20261027-164727 f0112]). New tiles get a random max level of 2 to 4 [wiki].
rules.one_enchantment: A tile can hold one enchantment, except Free-Play [wiki].
rules.floor: Damage and cooldown do not go below 0 [hyp].
rules.shrine_flow: Click a hand tile: it moves into the statue's mouth and UPGRADE lights up; click UPGRADE. REROLL costs coins; SKIP leaves [bot: collect 20261027-164727 f0109-f0112].
rules.tile_choice_flow: Click a pedestal tile to add it to the hand; REROLL costs coins; SKIP leaves [bot: collect 20261027-164727 f0042-f0043].

enchantments.name: Shockwave
enchantments.text: On hit, enemies adjacent to the target take 1 damage each.

enchantments.name: Perfect Strike
enchantments.text: Recharges the tile if the attack leaves the target at exactly 0 HP.

enchantments.name: Poison
enchantments.text: Poisoned enemies take 1 damage at the end of the turn for 3 turns.

enchantments.name: Curse
enchantments.text: Curses the enemy on hit; it takes double damage from the next hit.

enchantments.name: Freeplay
enchantments.text: Adding the tile to the queue does not pass the turn.

shop_rules: Each purchase raises that upgrade's price by the number of times it has been bought; slot-increasing upgrades never consume slots [wiki].
reroll: The first reroll costs 3 coins and the price rises with each reroll and with region progress [wiki] [bot: REROLL 3].
